name: Nacho Sánchez Amor - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Kyrgyz Republic, of the other part
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on a new partnership agreement between the EU and Kyrgyzstan, which was signed in June 2024 and replaces a 1999 agreement. The report says yes to closer cooperation on trade, energy, education and security, but strongly criticises Kyrgyzstan's record on human rights, media freedom and democracy. It asks Kyrgyzstan to release jailed journalists and activists and repeal repressive laws, and wants the agreement checked within three years, with possible suspension if rights commitments are not met.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament sets conditions and asks for a rights review within three years.
- **Who it affects:** Kyrgyzstan's government, journalists, activists and civil society; EU trade and aid ties.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes on the agreement; if approved, both sides must show progress on rights.
